Activities.Title: Pipeline health review & MSX cleanup
Activities.Description: Surface at-risk committed deals, run hygiene checks, prioritize fixes, and update MSX with clean data and forecast comments.
Activities.BusinessOutcome: Clean, accurate pipeline enabling reliable forecasting
Activities.BeginnerPrompt: Review my full pipeline: flag committed-at-risk deals by account with next best actions, then run a hygiene check — opportunities missing an updated close date, recent customer contact, or partner attach. Group by deal stage, prioritize by ARR closing this quarter, give me the single next fix for each flagged item, draft an updated forecast comment for stalled deals, and flag any work in progress that should be captured as a new opportunity in MSX.
Activities.SuggestedOutputs: ["Auto-detects stale opportunities and missing data", "Groups issues by MCEM stage for systematic fixes", "Suggests next fix with owner assignment"]

Activities.Title: Pipeline gap analysis
Activities.Description: Diagnose why pipeline is stalled and identify the key drivers behind gaps to plan.
Activities.BusinessOutcome: Clean, accurate pipeline enabling reliable forecasting
Activities.BeginnerPrompt: Where is pipeline stalled for this quarter, and what are the key drivers behind my gap to plan? Break it down by deal stage, show which opportunities are creating the biggest gaps, and recommend where I should focus to close the delta.
Activities.SuggestedOutputs: ["Auto-detects stale opportunities and missing data", "Groups issues by MCEM stage for systematic fixes", "Suggests next fix with owner assignment"]

Activities.Title: MSX report filtering guidance
Activities.Description: Navigate MSX report filters and views to build, slice, and save reusable reports for pipeline and territory analysis.
Activities.BusinessOutcome: Clean, accurate pipeline enabling reliable forecasting
Activities.BeginnerPrompt: I need [report type] from MSX but don’t know the right filters — walk me through the slice/filter steps, build the view, and save it as a reusable report I can run again.
Activities.SuggestedOutputs: ["Auto-detects stale opportunities and missing data", "Groups issues by MCEM stage for systematic fixes", "Suggests next fix with owner assignment"]

Activities.Title: Account strategy & territory prioritization
Activities.Description: Develop account plans, segment accounts by growth potential and AI readiness, and prioritize territories to focus time and resources effectively.
Activities.BusinessOutcome: Focused execution on the highest-priority accounts and opportunities
Activities.BeginnerPrompt: Build a one-page account plan for [Account]: rank it against my top 10 accounts in [Territory] by priority driver (renewal, ECIF, whitespace, at-risk signal), map top 10 priorities by solution area, pipeline coverage vs. quota, partners attached, and the next 3 actions to advance each priority. Flag any priority missing an active opportunity or a specialist/SE engaged, and recommend the single highest-impact action per account for the next 5 business days.
Activities.SuggestedOutputs: ["Ranks accounts by priority signals", "Surfaces coverage and opportunity gaps", "Recommends next actions for the week"]

Activities.Title: Account 360 prep
Activities.Description: Get a full account picture including stakeholder map, competitive landscape, and this week's top moves before any engagement.
Activities.BusinessOutcome: Focused execution on the highest-priority accounts and opportunities
Activities.BeginnerPrompt: Review the full account context for [Account]: active opportunities, last-30-day meetings, key emails, pipeline status, and stakeholder map. Summarize priorities, buying signals, risks, competitive mentions, and the 3 actions I should take this week — including which account-team roles are engaged and any gaps I need to fill before my next customer conversation.
Activities.SuggestedOutputs: ["Ranks accounts by priority signals", "Surfaces coverage and opportunity gaps", "Recommends next actions for the week"]

Activities.Title: Weekly forecast narrative
Activities.Description: Own forecast accuracy through inspection, deal reviews, and commitment cadence aligned to the Area rhythm.
Activities.BusinessOutcome: Accurate forecasting with proactive risk identification
Activities.BeginnerPrompt: Give me my weekly forecast narrative for the Area call: qualified vs. committed change since last week, the 5 biggest movers up and down with a one-line reason each, any committed deals at risk in the next 30 days, and 3 inspection questions to bring to my manager 1:1.
Activities.SuggestedOutputs: ["Summarises forecast movement and rationale", "Flags committed-at-risk deals", "Creates inspection questions for manager reviews"]

Activities.Title: Forecast accuracy & trend analysis
Activities.Description: Track forecast accuracy trends and identify patterns in commitment variance to improve future predictions.
Activities.BusinessOutcome: Accurate forecasting with proactive risk identification
Activities.BeginnerPrompt: Analyze my forecast accuracy over the past 4 quarters: show the variance between committed and actual by deal stage, identify which opportunity types I consistently over- or under-forecast, and recommend 3 specific changes to my forecasting approach this quarter.
Activities.SuggestedOutputs: ["Summarises forecast movement and rationale", "Flags committed-at-risk deals", "Creates inspection questions for manager reviews"]

Activities.Title: On-demand report generation
Activities.Description: Generate territory, consumption, and pipeline reports on demand for management reviews and stakeholder requests.
Activities.BusinessOutcome: Accurate forecasting with proactive risk identification
Activities.BeginnerPrompt: Generate my territory and Azure consumption reports for tomorrow’s review, formatted for management. Include a self-serve summary the requesting stakeholders can pull themselves.
Activities.SuggestedOutputs: ["Summarises forecast movement and rationale", "Flags committed-at-risk deals", "Creates inspection questions for manager reviews"]

Activities.Title: Customer engagement & value narrative
Activities.Description: Lead executive conversations, create value stories mapping solutions to priorities, and drive strategic alignment discussions.
Activities.BusinessOutcome: Better customer conversations grounded in recent context and priorities
Activities.BeginnerPrompt: Prepare me for my next conversation with [Account]: their priorities from the last 60 days, sentiment shifts, open commitments, competitive mentions, and 3 talking points plus the single ask that moves the deal forward. Then create an executive value story for [Solution]: map it to their top priorities, quantify outcomes (cost savings, productivity, risk reduction) using recent meeting and usage signals, and end with 3 CxO talking points and the key ask.
Activities.SuggestedOutputs: ["Summarises recent customer context", "Highlights priorities, risks and open commitments", "Creates talking points and next-step asks"]

Activities.Title: Executive value communication

Include 3 CxO-ready talking points I can reference in our follow-up call.

Include current empowerment and pricing rules, and flag any that have expired or changed this quarter.

Activities.Title: Deal health & risk mitigation
